title: 第11章 路上遇到袭杀第12章 接二连三的想谋害君家神子
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: “叮咚，系统已为宿主作出三个选项，第一就是可以直接用来转化修为，但成效不大，圣人大成都突破不了。”
“第二：系统出手帮你屏蔽掉大帝的探测，但出手一次将耗费五十万系统币一次，出手一次，时效为持一日”。
“第三：系统可以帮宿主自动监测，发现有大帝神念探查，系统即刻自动隐藏宿主修为，大帝探查过后，系统又会撤销自动隐藏，期效十日，一百万系统币。”
听完系统给的选择，林琅天倒吸一口冷气，这一百万极品灵石也太不经花了吧？
经过心中盘算，第一是可以放弃了，用了跟没用一样。
至于第二跟第三嘛，看起来作用都一样，系统都会主动出手，但第二个看起来没有第三个好，第三机动性好，时间也长。
心思选定，“系统，我选择第三个”
“叮咚，系统已为宿主作出规划，从有大帝神念探查开始，从那一天开始算起为第一日，请宿主多多努力挣钱。”
“系统，你之前说的钱没了，商城就会关闭，这一百万应该算是挣到钱了吧！商城应该不会关闭了吧！”
林琅天突然想起来了，之前系统的话。
“请宿主放心，自然是算的，不过只是时间拉长了，要是时间到了，宿主还是没挣到钱还是会关的噢，宿主不可怠慢，请继续努力”
“时效是多久？”林琅天关心重点。
“叮咚，系统为宿主拉长到了一个月的时间，一月过去，没有收入，就会关闭。”
“系统，我怎么感觉像是在帮你打工一样？”
“宿主想多了，这是为你自己打工，你拼命的挣钱，然后自己一步一步的走的巅峰”
好吧，话虽如此，但总感觉不对劲，可林琅天又发现不了哪有问题，只能先好好努力挣钱吧，你没钱，连系统大爷都帮不你了。
时间就这样点滴流逝，林琅天不停的看着远处风景，天渐渐入夜，但身为圣人境，夜如白昼，毫无分别。
“系统，在吗？我总感觉有什么东西在身后跟随一样”
林琅天从林家出来后就一直有这种感觉，之前没留意，现在却一直悬在心头。
“叮咚，宿主身后是有一名大圣境巅峰的人，一直在后面跟着，只不过检测到对方没恶意，就没有提醒宿主”。
“果然，看来我的感受不会错，真的有人在跟随，想来这个应该是神子的护道人吧，堂堂君家神子出门，怎么可能没有护道人呢？”
想清楚了之后，林琅天也就没在意了，看了一眼大舅哥，君傲天修炼很是认真，看来出身是一回事，努力又是一回事。
出身好，天资高，又努力向上，君家神子不出色才怪，同辈远远早就给甩身后了吧。
再往前一步就是悟道境了，这可是很多一些小宗门长老，家族族老也是这个境界。
夜越来越深，林琅天感觉有一股风雨，欲来之兆，这种感觉就像是有什么东西压在心头上，令人感觉不爽，浑身透不过气一样。
前世看多了小说，知道有些敌对的宗族见不得，敌手的后辈子弟天资出色，所以有很多见不得人的手段，截路拦杀是再正常不过的事。
林琅天心想，不会是我遇上这种桥段了吧，我应该不应该提醒下君傲天呢，毕竟再怎么说也是便宜的大舅哥了。
相信这种情况，身后的护道人应该也早就发现不对劲了吧。
就在林琅天还在犹豫，要不要告诉君傲天，告诉了又会不会漏泄，自己的不平凡之时。
君傲天突然入定中醒来了，开口就是“有敌人来了，注意戒备”。
“嗯，看来是护道人通知君傲天了”林琅天也是暗松口气，有准备就好。
“那我们现在怎么办？”林琅天装作一副不知所措的样子。
“放心，这种情况君家遇到不少，见多不怪，不凡者才会招人妒忌”。
君傲天一副不在意的样子。
“来者不善，还是早做准备为好”林琅天出口提醒。
“嗯？你说的也对，两手准备才行”君傲天手中灵光一闪，出现一个玉符，在念念有词。
就在此刻……
前方出现一道巨掌，仿若跨越无尽时空，巨掌过处，空间层层崩溃，威逼而来…
content_en:
"Ding dong, the system has made three options for the host. The first is that it can be directly used to transform cultivation, but the effect is not great, and the saint can't break through it."
"Second: The system will take action to help you block the Great Emperor's detection, but one action will cost 500,000 system coins. One action will last for one day."
"Third: The system can automatically monitor the host. If it is discovered that the emperor's spiritual consciousness is probing, the system will immediately automatically hide the host's cultivation level. After the emperor's inspection, the system will cancel the automatic hiding. It will be valid for ten days and one million system coins."
After hearing the choices given by the system, Lin Langtian took a breath of air. Isn't this one million top-grade spiritual stones too wasteful?
After careful consideration, the first thing is to give up. Using it will be as useless as using it.
As for the second and third ones, they seem to have the same effect, and the system will take the initiative. However, the second one does not seem to be as good as the third one. The third one is more maneuverable and takes longer.
The mind made a choice, "System, I choose the third one"
"Ding dong, the system has made a plan for the host. Starting from the time when the Great Emperor's mind is detected, that day will be counted as the first day. Please work hard to make money for the host."
"System, if the money you said before is gone, the mall will be closed. This million should be regarded as money earned! The mall should not be closed!"
Lin Langtian suddenly remembered what the system said before.
"Please rest assured, host, it will be taken care of naturally, but the time is just extended. If the time is up, the host still hasn't made any money and will still be locked up. Host, please don't neglect, please continue to work hard."
"How long is the statute of limitations?" Lin Langtian was concerned.
"Ding dong, the system has extended the time for the host to one month. After one month passes, if there is no income, it will be shut down."
"System, why do I feel like I'm working for you?"
"The host thinks too much. This is working for yourself. You work hard to make money, and then you can reach the top step by step."
Well, having said that, something still feels wrong, but Lin Langtian can't find what's wrong, so he can only work hard to make money first. If you don't have money, even the system uncle can't help you.
Time passed like this, and Lin Langtian kept looking at the scenery in the distance. It was gradually turning into night, but as a saint, night was like day, without distinction.
"System, are you there? I always feel like there is something following behind me."
Lin Langtian has been feeling this way since he came out of the Lin family. He didn't notice it before, but now it's always on his mind.
"Ding dong, there is a person at the peak of the Great Saint Realm behind the host. He has been following him. However, he detected that the other party did not have any malicious intent, so he did not alert the host."
"Sure enough, it seems that my feeling is not wrong. Someone is really following me. I think this person should be the protector of the Son of God. How could there be no protector when the Son of God of the Jun family goes out?"
After thinking about it clearly, Lin Langtian stopped caring. He glanced at his uncle, Jun Aotian, who was practicing very seriously. It seemed that one's background was one thing, and hard work was another.
With a good background, high talent, and hard work, it would be strange if the Jun family's divine son was not outstanding. He must have been far behind his peers.
One step further is the realm of enlightenment. This is the realm for many elders of small sects and clan elders.
As the night got deeper and deeper, Lin Langtian felt a storm coming, a sign that something was coming. It felt like something was pressing on his heart, making him feel uncomfortable and suffocating.
I had read too many novels in my previous life, and I knew that some hostile clans were unscrupulous, and the enemy's descendants had outstanding talents, so they used many shady methods, and it was normal to intercept and kill them.
Lin Langtian thought to himself, I am not the one who encountered such a situation. I should not remind Jun Aotian. After all, he is a cheap uncle after all.
I believe that in this case, the guardian behind him should have noticed something was wrong a long time ago.
Just when Lin Langtian was still hesitating whether to tell Jun Aotian or not, whether telling him would reveal that he was extraordinary.
Jun Aotian suddenly woke up from trance and said, "An enemy is coming, be careful."
"Well, it seems that the guardian has informed Jun Aotian." Lin Langtian also breathed a sigh of relief, just be prepared.
"Then what should we do now?" Lin Langtian pretended to be at a loss.
"Don't worry, the Jun family has encountered many situations like this. Don't be surprised if you see them often. Only extraordinary people will make people jealous."
Jun Aotian looked unconcerned.
"If the visitor is not malicious, it's better to prepare early," Lin Langtian reminded him.
"Huh? You're right, you have to prepare both hands." A flash of light flashed in Jun Aotian's hand, and a jade talisman appeared, muttering something.
Right now...
A giant palm appeared in front, as if it spanned endless time and space. Wherever the giant palm passed, the space collapsed layer by layer, threatening...
title_en: Chapter 11: Attacked on the road Chapter 12: Continuous attempts to murder the divine son of the Jun family
